gedi-forest-height.name: GEDI Forest Canopy Height
gedi-forest-height.description: Global forest canopy height measured by NASA GEDI LiDAR aboard ISS. Brown/dark indicates low vegetation (<5m), bright green indicates medium canopy (~30m), and cyan/white denotes tall old-growth forests up to 60m.
gedi-forest-height.soundHint: Canopy height maps to pitch (deeper = shorter vegetation, high pitch = towering trees). Stereo pan matches geography.

night-lights.name: Change in Night Lights (2012–2023)
night-lights.description: Earth at Night urban illumination evolution over a decade. Dark backgrounds represent oceans and unlit land; bright clusters represent human settlements and power grids.
night-lights.soundHint: Light intensity controls volume and texture density. Sudden urban illumination pulses trigger subtle acoustic accents.

iss-lightning.name: Lightning Events from ISS (2017–2023)
iss-lightning.description: Global lightning strikes mapped from the ISS Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS). Individual storm systems create transient high-luminance bursts across continents.
iss-lightning.soundHint: Flashes trigger crisp percussive hits panned in stereo to strike coordinates (x=pan left/right, y=pitch or filter cutoff).

sst-currents.name: Sea Surface Currents & Temperature
sst-currents.description: High-resolution ECCO2 ocean model displaying thermal gradients from polar freezing waters (-2°C) to equatorial warmth (35°C), intertwined with flowing oceanic currents.
sst-currents.soundHint: Water temperature sets harmonic mode and pitch center. Current turbulence and flow velocity drive continuous ambient pad modulation.

geos-aerosols.name: GEOS Aerosols (Smoke, Dust, Sea Salt)
geos-aerosols.description: Atmospheric composition simulation showing movement of aerosols: desert dust (orange), wildfire smoke (red), ocean sea salt spray (blue), and volcanic/industrial sulfate (white).
geos-aerosols.soundHint: Each aerosol class modulates an independent sonic layer: dust=gritty bass drone, smoke=warm noise texture, sea salt=high harmonic shimmer.

dyamond-co2.name: DYAMOND Global Atmospheric CO2
dyamond-co2.description: Global 3D simulation of carbon dioxide concentrations transported by atmospheric circulation, showing emissions plumes and seasonal biosphere uptake.
dyamond-co2.soundHint: CO2 parts per million (ppm) directly shifts overall musical pitch and tension. Swelling regional plumes increase timbre brightness.

perpetual-ocean.name: Perpetual Ocean 2 (Western Boundary Currents)
perpetual-ocean.description: Surface ocean currents visualization capturing energetic mesoscale eddies and intense western boundary currents like the Gulf Stream and Kuroshio.
perpetual-ocean.soundHint: Streak brightness and swirling motion dictate rhythmic pulse rates and harmonic resonance.

air-quality.name: Air Quality Model Runs
air-quality.description: High-resolution air quality and particulate matter model simulation depicting local pollution transport across topography.
air-quality.soundHint: Clean air registers in pleasant consonant fifths; dense pollutant plumes introduce dissonance and filtered roughness.

atmospheric-river.name: 3D Atmospheric River
atmospheric-river.description: 3D volumetric simulation of atmospheric rivers carrying vast corridors of water vapor from the tropics to mid-latitude coastlines.
atmospheric-river.soundHint: Corridor vapor density modulates stereo width and chorus depth.

caldwell-73-scanner.name: Data Sonification: Caldwell 73 (Methodology Reference)
caldwell-73-scanner.description: NASA's pioneering astronomical sonification method translating x-axis to time, y-axis to pitch, and brightness to volume.
caldwell-73-scanner.soundHint: Full horizontal scanner mode enabled: scans left-to-right columns mapping vertical light distributions into melodic chords.
